entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Giovanni d'Andrea or Johannes Andreæ was an Italian expert in canon law. His contemporaries referred to him as iuris canonici fons et tuba. Most important among his works were extensive commentaries on all of the official collections of papal decretals, papal judgments in the form of letters to delegated judges that were at the core of canon law.
